prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a side impact at intersection. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1465; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the client in connection with injuries sustained in a side-impact collision at an intersection. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or through any representative. Kindly confirm in writing that you have received this notice and that the claim file has been opened.

We request disclosure of the bodily injury liability limits under each policy that may apply to the insured driver and vehicle involved in this incident, including any umbrella or excess coverage. Please also identify any other policies you believe may provide coverage.

We further ask that your insured and your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes vehicle data and event recorder information, photographs, dashcam or surveillance footage, witness statements, claim notes, recorded statements, repair and salvage records, and all related correspondence. Any destruction or alteration of such material could prejudice our client's claim, and we expect that reasonable steps will be taken to prevent it.

Our client is prepared to discuss resolution once the requested information has been provided. We look forward to your prompt response.
